name: Perfect Thrust
description: Adds a ring around the crosshair while charging an attack. It marks the moment letting go counts as a heavy attack and signals READY once every charge-dependent effect, such as the Thrust and Slow and Steady blessings, weapon windup bonuses or the Ogryn talent Crunch!, has reached its maximum stacks; without such effects, READY marks the heavy attack itself.
author: LucLeto
